scripts.db:apply: docker exec -i awdirektori-db-1 psql -U postgres -h 127.0.0.1 -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -q -f - < supabase/migrations/20261001000000_init.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f supabase/local/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f supabase/local/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && npm run db:apply
scripts.db:types: docker run --rm --network awdirektori_default -e PG_META_DB_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@db:5432/postgres -e PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES=typescript -e PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_INCLUDED_SCHEMAS=public -e PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_DETECT_ONE_TO_ONE_RELATIONSHIPS=true supabase/postgres-meta:v0.99.0 node dist/server/server.js > "app/(aw)/_lib/database.types.ts"
